I have enough to classify. Summary of what the document provides:

- **§13.2 (p0543–p0564):** an extensive RevMed-only warranty set — sole/exclusive ownership free of liens, no prior encumbrance, right to grant the licenses, non-infringement and non-misappropriation, patent validity/prosecution, no litigation, no government funding/Bayh-Dole, data-room completeness, and material compliance with Applicable Law in all R&D.
- **§13.1(c)–(e), §13.4 (p0571–p0572):** FCPA, Excluded List/debarment, permits, and ongoing compliance with all Applicable Law (including laws applicable to manufacture of human pharmaceuticals).
- **Performance standard:** §4/§5 conduct provisions (p0291, p0313) require all Research and Development activities to be performed in compliance with Applicable Law including GMP, GLP and GCP, with diligent efforts against plan timelines — the biopharma analogue of "professional and workmanlike."
- **Remedy:** §14.1(b)–(c) (p0583–p0584) indemnity for material breach of RevMed's warranties or obligations, and §12.6 (p0534) expressly preserves all other remedies (termination is not the sole remedy).
- **Disclaimer:** §13.5 (p0574) is mutual and opens "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII" — it does not swallow the express warranties, and it equally protects us.

No conformance-to-documentation period or malicious-code warranty is needed here (no software/deliverables construct); product quality warranties are properly deferred to the Supply and Quality Agreements under §7.3.

input.quote: 13.5 No Other Warranties. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII, (A) NO REPRESENTATION, CONDITION OR WARRANTY WHATSOEVER IS MADE OR GIVEN BY OR ON BEHALF OF SANOFI OR REVMED; AND (B) ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES WHETHER WRITTEN OR ORAL OR EXPRESS OR IMPLIED ARE HEREBY EXPRESSLY EXCLUDED, INCLUDING ANY CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.
input.rationale: The rule is met at or above the preferred position, as translated to this collaboration/license structure. RevMed gives an extensive, one-way express warranty package in §13.2 (sole and exclusive ownership of RevMed Background Technology free of liens, no prior encumbrance or conflicting grant, right to grant the licenses, non-infringement and non-misappropriation to its Knowledge, patent validity and proper prosecution/maintenance, no litigation or adverse proceedings, no government funding/Bayh-Dole taint, data-room completeness, and §13.2(u) material compliance with all Applicable Law in the conduct of all R&D), reinforced by the §13.1(c)-(e) FCPA/Excluded List/permits reps and the §13.4 mutual no-debarment and Applicable Law compliance covenants. The "professional and workmanlike" analogue is present as a substantive performance standard: p0291 and p0313 require all Research and Development activities to be performed in compliance with Applicable Law including GMP, GLP and GCP, with diligent efforts against the applicable Plan timelines. A real remedy exists: §14.1(b)-(c) gives us indemnification for material breach of RevMed's warranties or obligations, and §12.6 confirms termination is not the sole remedy and that all other remedies remain available, so ordinary damages and specific performance survive. Critically, the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty: §13.5 is mutual (it protects Sanofi equally) and is expressly prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII," so the Article XIII warranties are fully carved out — this is nowhere near the "AS IS" walk-away. Noted for the file rather than flagged: there is no fixed conformance-to-documentation warranty period, no repair/replace/refund mechanic and no malicious-code warranty, but those preferred sub-elements are artifacts of a software/services deal and have no application to a research collaboration with no software or fixed deliverables; product quality and GMP conformance warranties are deliberately and appropriately deferred to the Supply Agreement and Quality Agreement to be negotiated under §7.3, which is the customary and correct home for them. No redline warranted.
